finalText:
All objectives complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket created: ref **RD-1015**, title "fwrd83-n1 RD Bench Ticket", customer "Marley Street Cafe", initial status Draft. (Only "Title" was required on the create form; customer was optional.)

**2. DONE** — Part "fwrd83-n1 RD Part A" added with cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1. App-computed price: **$125.00** (ticket parts total $125.00).

**3. DONE** — Part "fwrd83-n1 RD Part B" added with cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1. App-computed price: **$250.00** (ticket parts total $375.00).

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup 25%, qty 1 unchanged). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (ticket parts total $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00).

**5. DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready**. Preconditions discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" while parts had no supplier was refused with the alert: *"Ticket is not ready / Part "fwrd83-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd83-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. I satisfied it by opening each part's Edit dialog and filling the free-text Supplier field (there is no supplier dropdown — it's a plain text input) with "Bosch Service Parts" for both parts; the parts table then showed a supplier instead of "No supplier", and "Mark Ready" was accepted. The Status label changed from Draft to **Ready** (buttons became "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed"); the app shows no toast/alert confirmation, only the label/button swap. State persisted after a page reload.

**6. DONE** — Both parts removed and the ticket archived. Each part's Delete button opened an in-page Confirm modal ("Cancel" / "Delete part"); the app did not refuse deletion while the ticket was Ready. After both deletions the parts table showed "No parts on this ticket yet." with 0 parts and no total row. "Archive ticket" was accepted with no error or additional requirement (button changed to "Unarchive ticket"). Final verification on the tickets list: searching "fwrd83-n1" with "Show archived" unchecked returns **0 rows** ("No tickets match the current filters."); with "Show archived" checked it returns exactly 1 row — **RD-1015 | fwrd83-n1 RD Bench Ticket [Archived badge] | Marley Street Cafe | Status Ready | Parts 0 | 2026-09-22**. Nothing created by this run remains active.
